title: Covariance with a constant function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The covariance, under the product distribution with one-coordinate law $\pi$, of the constant function with value $c\in\mathbb R$ and $g$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
